body.purpose: Hero body copy. Comfortable reading weight.

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Uppercase tracked text link for external navigation. Dot-separated inline layout.
components.html: LinkedIn·GitHub·Email
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0; font-family: var(--font-outfit, Outfit, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-nav-link { color: #6a6a6a; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; padding: 10px 12px; min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; transition: color 200ms ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #111111; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-nav-dot { color: #c0c0c0; }

components.name: Theme Toggle
components.description: Fixed-position sun/moon icon button for light/dark theme switching. Two overlapping 18px SVGs swap via opacity and transform.
components.html: <button class="ds-theme-toggle" aria-label="Switch to light mode"><svg class="ds-toggle-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><!-- sun: circle + 8 rays --></svg><svg class="ds-toggle-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><!-- moon: crescent path --></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-theme-toggle { position: fixed; bottom: 24px; right: 24px; background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 14px; min-height: 44px; min-width: 44px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; z-index: 10; } .ds-toggle-icon { position: absolute; width: 18px; height: 18px; color: var(--text-ui); transition: opacity 200ms ease, transform 200ms ease, color 200ms ease; } .ds-theme-toggle:hover .ds-toggle-icon { color: var(--text-ui-hover); } .ds-theme-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Divider Line
components.description: Gradient horizontal rule with ambient pulse animation.
components.css: .ds-divider { height: 1px; width: 192px; margin: 0 auto; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06) 20%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) 50%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06) 80%, transparent); animation: ds-line-pulse 5s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-line-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 0.5; } 50% { opacity: 1; } }

narrative.overview:
Every element is machined to tolerance. Nothing decorative, nothing performative. The site communicates through material density and deliberate compression: a name rendered at display scale in a single ultralight weight, body copy that earns each word, and navigation reduced to three contact points separated by dots.

The system rejects developer-portfolio templates (dark mode + terminal font + GitHub stats), SaaS marketing patterns (gradient blobs, feature grids, CTA stacking), hollow minimalism (white page with tiny text that reads as unfinished), and spectacle-driven animation (scroll-jacking, particles, 3D scenes). Restraint here is not absence. It is the residue of removing everything that does not communicate competence.
keyCharacteristics: Single-family typography (Outfit) carrying the entire hierarchy through weight and scale alone
Pure neutral palette with no accent color; the absence of color is the statement
Flat elevation; depth conveyed through ambient light and texture, never shadows
Centered single-column composition at a narrow measure

rules.name: The No-Color Rule
rules.body: There is no accent color. If a future element needs emphasis, it earns it through weight, scale, or spacing. Color is not available as a tool for hierarchy.

rules.name: The Single-Family Rule
rules.body: Outfit carries every role. No secondary typeface. The hierarchy must be legible through weight and scale contrast within one family.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never cast shadows. If a component needs to separate from the ground, it uses value contrast or spacing, never elevation.

dos: Do use weight and scale as the primary hierarchy tools. A 200-weight display next to 400-weight labels creates contrast without color.
Do keep the warm tint in neutrals. #fafaf8, not #ffffff. #111111, not #000000. The warmth is subtle but load-bearing.
Do respect the narrow measure. Content stays within max-w-lg (32rem). The compression is deliberate.
Do use generous fluid vertical rhythm between sections (clamp-based spacing, e.g. clamp(1.5rem, 1rem + 1.5vw, 2rem) to clamp(2.5rem, 1.5rem + 3vw, 3.5rem)) while keeping horizontal padding tight.
Do maintain 44px minimum touch targets on all interactive elements.
donts: Don't add an accent color. The No-Color Rule is a commitment, not a gap.
Don't add shadows or elevation to any surface. The No-Shadow Rule is absolute.
Don't introduce a second typeface without retiring Outfit. One family, committed.
Don't use terminal fonts, GitHub contribution graphs, or project card grids.
Don't add gradient blobs, feature grids, logo bars, or stacking CTAs.
Don't use scroll-jacking, particle effects, or 3D scenes.
Don't add sections that require assets you don't have.
Don't use bounce or elastic easing. Exponential ease-out only.
